title: Embedding Consistency Regulation for Persistent Semantic Routing in Compact Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.00543v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language models are increasingly deployed under tight memory and compute constraints, where semantic routes (e.g., language, tone, or intent) may be assigned before decoding. However, these routes may not remain reflected in generated responses. We study this phenomenon as \emph{persistent semantic routing}. We investigate this property using Embedding Consistency Regulation (ECR) as a minimal probe. ECR derives a short discrete prefix for each input using a frozen embedding model and applies the same prefix construction during both training and inference. In controlled prefix-assignment experiments, ECR achieves 99.93\% $\pm$ 0.12\% language routing accuracy, while random, shuffled, and dummy controls remain near chance (34--36\%). This gap is not reliably captured by likelihood: some controls achieve competitive NLL despite losing routing consistency. translated_title: 面向紧凑语言模型持久语义路由的嵌入一致性调节
translated_abstract: 语言模型越来越多地在严格的内存和计算约束下部署，在这种场景中，语义路由（例如语言、语气或意图）可能在解码之前就被分配。然而，这些路由可能无法在生成的响应中持续得到体现。我们将这一现象作为“持久语义路由”进行研究。我们使用嵌入一致性调节（Embedding Consistency Regulation, ECR）作为一个最小探针来考察这一特性。ECR利用一个冻结的嵌入模型为每个输入导出一段简短的离散前缀，并在训练和推理阶段采用相同的前缀构建方式。在受控的前缀分配实验中，ECR实现了99.93% ± 0.12%的语言路由准确率，而随机、打乱和虚拟对照组仅接近随机水平（34–36%）。这一差距无法被似然指标可靠地捕捉：一些对照组尽管失去了路由一致性，却仍取得了具有竞争力的负对数似然（NLL）。我们进一步提出了响应路由可恢复性（Response Routing Recoverability, RRR），这是一种独立于编码器的诊断……
tldr: 该论文提出嵌入一致性调节（ECR）方法，通过冻结嵌入模型为输入生成离散前缀，使紧凑语言模型在解码后仍能持续体现预分配的语义路由（如语言、语气、意图），实现99.93%的语言路由准确率，并引入独立于编码器的响应路由可恢复性（RRR）诊断指标。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Embedding Consistency Regulation (ECR), which derives short discrete prefixes from a frozen embedding model so that compact language models persistently reflect pre-assigned semantic routes (language, tone, intent) in generated responses, achieving 99.93% language routing accuracy, and introduces Response Routing Recoverability (RRR) as an encoder-independent diagnostic metric.
